classification.basis: The pinned Microsoft WSL ETW profile captured 180 GuestLog records from the custom VM. They prove Linux 6.18.40.1+ entry, Hyper-V detection, CPU/memory/clock initialization, initramfs unpack, and execution of stock /init. No VMBus device enumeration occurred, so B2 is not proved. mini_init executed but did not remain alive, so B4 is not assigned.

firstObservableFailure: The kernel could not open an initial console; mini_init reported missing /dev/hvc1 and /dev/console.
fatalControlPlaneFailure: mini_init UtilConnectVsock failed with errno 97 (EAFNOSUPPORT), then halted. CONFIG_VSOCKETS and CONFIG_HYPERV_VSOCKETS were disabled.

rootCauseAssessment.missingConsole: observed but not the final fatal error
rootCauseAssessment.missingVmbusRuntimeEnumeration: observed; CONFIG_HYPERV_VMBUS=y alone did not probe without the x86 platform enumeration substrate
rootCauseAssessment.missingVsockProtocolAndHyperVTransport: directly implicated by EAFNOSUPPORT and disabled CONFIG_VSOCKETS/CONFIG_HYPERV_VSOCKETS

decision: Retain the Hyper-V execution core. The next coherent discovery bundle should add the minimal x86 ACPI/platform-enumeration closure needed for VMBus plus built-in CONFIG_VSOCKETS and CONFIG_HYPERV_VSOCKETS. Do not add storage, networking, or the separate virtio/HVC console bundle yet. A new explicit decision is required before booting that candidate.
